articleTitle: Question Answering System for Healthcare Information based on BERT and GPT
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Recently, demand for telemedicine counseling has been on the rise. Although telemedicine is legally prohibited in Korea, the number of healthcare-related questions on online question and answer platforms is steadily increasing. However, doctors have to manually write answers to similar questions, which is time-consuming and inefficient. This study implemented a healthcare information provision question and answer system using an algorithm that combines BERT and GPT-2 structures. Intellectual Q&A pairs were used as training data, and the BERT-GPT algorithm experimented with creating sentences that provide healthcare information such as related medical subjects and suspected diseases as answers to healthcare-related questions. As a result of BERT-GPT2 algorithm gets worse PPL score and loss than the baseline model, but better score in the qualitative assessment. This result means BERT-GPT2 understands the conversation intention better.

articleTitle: Classification of Pineapple Fiber Woven Fabrics Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this research, we propose a method for classifying 4 types of pineapple fiber woven fabrics which are pure pineapple fiber woven fabrics, manual-connected pure pineapple fiber woven fabrics, machine-connected pure pineapple fiber woven fabrics, and blended pineapple fiber-cotton textile fabric. Each type can refer to the quality and price of these fabrics. The proposed technique is based on transfer learning of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Transfer learning can be separated into 3 steps which are modifying the pretrained network, model training, and assessing the model. The Resnet50 was selected to be our transfer learning network. Finally, the experimental result shows that the classification performance in terms of class accuracy is 95.83 % on average.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition for People with Knee Abnormality Using Surface Electromyography and Knee Angle Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: With the onset of technological advancements, biosensors are being effectively used in a variety of contexts, including the diagnosis of diseases, the promotion of their prevention and rehabilitation, the monitoring of patient health, and human activity recognition (HAR). Recently, HAR research results have been obtained and applied in many commercial applications such as fall detection using smart watch sensors, activity classification using smart home sensors. However, previous HAR models utilizing wearable sensors primarily utilized data from healthy individuals, and such models are frequently inaccurate when applied to individuals with medical mobility impairments. In this work, surface electromyography and goniometer sensors were used to categorize various types of rehabilitation activities based on HAR models developed for individuals with knee abnormalities. To achieve the goal of our study, a deep residual network called ResNeXt was proposed to detect human activities with high performance. To investigate the classification performance of deep learning models, a 5-fold cross-validation technique was applied for both training and testing. Based on the results of our study, the combination of features extracted from the goniometer and electromyograph signals resulted in the highest F1-score (93.31%) and the best accuracy (93.52%).

articleTitle: Improving Inertial Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition using Ensemble Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Sensor-based human activity recognition (S-HAR) is a famous study focusing on detecting human physiological actions by interpreting various sensors, especially one-dimensional time series information. Typically, S-HAR machine learning methods were developed using handcrafted characteristics. Unfortunately, this is a complicated process that involves feature engineering and a high level of domain knowledge. Due to the development of deep neural networks, classification techniques could efficiently handle relevant characteristics from raw sensor data, resulting in enhanced classification outcomes. In this study, we describe a unique method for S-HAR based on ensemble deep learning with sensor nodes connected to the waist, chest, leg, and arm. Implementing and training three deep learning networks is performed using a publically available dataset, including wearable sensors from eight human actions. The findings demonstrate that the proposed Ens-ResNeXt model provides the maximum accuracy and F1-score, which is superior to existing techniques.

articleTitle: Free Opensource Mobile GIS Applications for Land Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Geography location and object report is a key aspect in field survey, nevertheless of the spatial level. This research shown the request of land survey by using no code software. The study process collects data in the first part, mainly using forms and brief descriptions. Later on technologies are applied with increasing the availability of smartphone and improvement of features of the smartphones. Detection expose that smartphone GIS technique has a high adeptness, precision and consistency as a data collection technique for land survey development. Additional the study can be developed to use more advanced equipment.

articleTitle: Proposal of Human-like Spatiotemporal Language Understanding Based on Mental Image Model for Language-centered Human-Robot Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Mental-image based spatiotemporal (4D) language understanding in human was considered from the viewpoint of cognitive science and simulated based on the mental image model proposed in mental image directed semantic theory (MIDST). The application system was evaluated based on a psychological experiment involving human subjects and found a good success in answering questions concerning the scenes expressed in 4D language.

articleTitle: The Development of Virtual Reality to Present Cultural Tourist Attractions, the Nine Pagodas in Chiang Rai Province
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The purposes of the research were 1) to develop virtual reality to Present Cultural Tourist Attractions, the Nine Pagodas in Chiang Rai Province and 2) to investigate the satisfaction level of using virtual reality to Present Cultural Tourist Attractions public relations by questionnaire and by studying the literature review. The virtual reality was applied by 3D Vista. articleTitle: Using Customer Knowledge for Geese Farm Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The poultry market demand is expected to be higher by 2050 compared to 2010. However, Geese farmers lack scientific Knowledge leading to low survival rates and poor product quality. This research aims to improve customer satisfaction by i) identifying problems in geese farms and ii) using Customer Knowledge Management to design a research framework. Demographic analysis, Text Mining, Kano questionnaire, and Arrow diagramming are used to gather customer data and identify critical areas. The proposed solution is to enhance geese farmers' Knowledge using the Community of Practice.

articleTitle: A System for Live Coding that Realizes a Unified Production of Real Space and Virtual Space
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: We are studying live coding and exploring its possibilities. As part of this, we have designed and developed a system that unified controls stage lighting in real space and objects in virtual space and made it possible to link with Sonic Pi, a musical live coding system. Furthermore, we tried to associate the representation of music by stage lighting in real space with the representation of objects in virtual space. This research is related to the fact that it not only introduces a new field of the control system to the conventional live coding, which mainly generates music and video in real time but also extends it to the virtual space and fuses it. It has a uniqueness that is not found in related works. As a result of this research, music-related live coders will be able to perform music by themselves while performing real space production with stage lighting and virtual space production with objects. This not only means that it is possible to produce stage and virtual spaces that directly reflect the performer's intentions but also has the potential to greatly affect the way live music and concerts are and how they are streaming.

articleTitle: Equivalent of Character Design for Design Thinking in Personal Character Design Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Personal character has gained its popularity in digital platforms. Picking and editing one from a list in a package software, the user can simply create a character for general use. To be more masterly, guided by the specific needs of the user, a character design process helps a professional designer customize the most appropriate character for a precise job. Design thinking is a first - line process in design work, which is based on effective critical thinking, and its framework is user - centered method to solve problems and other activities, while character design process is based on character design methodology, which is employed in customizing a specific character. This study aims to survey common practices in design thinking and character design processes in creating a unique personal character to comprehend the relevance of their methods. The expected result is process of design thinking for effective idea development and productive character design process.

articleTitle: CNN Transfer Learning for Two Stage Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy using Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a common retina disease caused by diabetes, which is increasing rapidly worldwide along with diabetic Mellitus. It is very difficult to diagnose in the beginning as it is asymptomatic, which leads to blindness. Presently, there are about 422 million diabetes patients, and it is projected that the number will be 552 million in 2030, as per a report from the World Health Organization. With the advancement in Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision fields, many CNN-powered models have been developed for the detection and classification of DR using color fundus images. Early diagnosis of DR will increase recovery and decrease the possibility of vision loss threats. In this study, we aim to classify Diabetic Retinopathy in two stages, diseased versus healthy images. Three different pre-trained CNN models, namely, VGG16, InceptionV3, and MobileNet were deployed through transfer learning. Messidor and Messidor-2, two publicly available datasets are used in the training and testing of these CNN models. In terms of classification accuracy, the highest result of 84% was obtained using InceptionV3, whereas MobileNet and VGG16 shows 83% and 78% accuracy, respectively. The Highest 86 % precision for the healthy class and 88% sensitivity for the diseased class is shown by VGG16.

articleTitle: Ontology Creation based on Digital Transformation for Supply Chain Resilience
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The disruption of the supply chain happens more frequently than in the past; meanwhile the organization is struggling with insufficient digital transformation for supply chain resilience. This research is going to conduct an ontology from the journal text to enable enterprise transfer to digital transformation. Use the database of the Web of science core collection; based on the R package, and we do the text mining from the top-20 high citation article to filter out related terms from the perspective of tf and tf-idf, manually select the ontologies to build up a roadmap integrated a three-line defense of supply chain resilience to matches the before, during, after disruption stages.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Gamelan's Sound Manipulation Toward the Mood of Calm on Teenagers
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study examines the effects of Javanese gamelan instrumental music on inducing calm. Music has been used for ages for hypnosis or “mind washing.” Based on instinctive reaction and conditioned reflex, the physiological psychological model employing music stimuli has spread the belief that music can affect self-control. Hypnotherapy's music-induced relaxation helps “physiological psychology” as a reflex response to sound. From hypnosis induced by musical instrument sounds and genres to conditioned reflexes that impact physiology through conscious thought. Mesmer used the managed universe hypothesis to heal patients in the 1770s. Thus, “magnetic sleep” may have inspired hypnosis for relaxation. Magnetism is a “sympathetic vibration” that is communicable, disseminated, and strengthened through sound. Western musical instruments dominate, whereas Eastern ethnic instruments like gamelan are rarely utilized. This study used a quasi-experimental, one-post-test design on the same group. The study included teens without hearing or health issues. N = 20 individuals passively listened to a Javanese gamelan composition based on gender, gambang, and gong for 5.5 minutes, then completed self-report questionnaires and integrated group discussions. 67.5% of subjects did not feel drowsy, 81.3% believed the listening duration was not long, and 86% were satisfied with the music intervention. 32.5% were a little tired, 18.7% thought it was too long, and 14.5% were satisfied. However, several individuals experienced Bluetooth headset signal interference while listening, which led to these results. Thus, music relaxes all subjects, proving the idea.

articleTitle: Factors affecting the decision to choose dormitory accommodation among students of the College of Arts, Media and Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study aims to study the marketing mix of 7P's factors affecting the rental property service selection in post covid-19 period of the College of Arts, Media, and Technology students. The online questionnaire was designed based on 7Ps marketing mix and conducted through used to investigate through 300 students. Hypotheses were set to analyze through F-test in one-way ANOVA and linear regression analysis. The results reveal that the ranking of factors concerned in this study are these following opinions on the product, price, human, process, and physical appearance are at the most important level. Distribution channels and marketing promotion were at a very important level. Hypotheses testing results showed that only educational level and domicile factors did not affect the choice of rental property service selection. In addition, there were three out of seven factors from 7Ps which influencing the rental service selection which are physical evident and product factors, respectively.

articleTitle: A Survey of Industry in Cambodia and Future Prospects Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In developed countries, industry 4.0 revolution is growing towards automation and data cloud analysis in manufacturing technologies to create a smart and high-class factory which be able to make higher production and logistics systems with few employees. This paper is based on a project funded by the ERASMUS+ Program of the European Union: ASEAN Factori 4.0, Across South East Asian Nations: From Automation and Control Training to the Overall Roll-out of Industry 4.0, 609854-EPP-1-2019-1-FREPPKA2-CBHE-JP which provided for a great survey of Cambodia industries in order to develop universities programs of automated production system. With these results of surveyed industries contributes to the Telecommunication and Electronic Engineering Department of Royal University of Phnom Penh recognizing where to begin for requirement of future industry 4.0 in Cambodia, such as automated production, applied technologies, and programing skills. In short of future, Cambodia will be extended for Industry 4.0 technologies with 5G, data centers, artificial intelligent (AI), industrial Automation (IA), additive manufacturing, industrial internet of things (IIoT) and smart factories, intelligent management, cyber-security, and machine learning as similar as other developed Asian countries.

articleTitle: Attack Performance Model Analysis: Outside Spiker of the Champion Women's Team in Volleyball Nations League 2022
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This research is an analysis of the attack performance model for the Volleyball Nations League 2022. The VNL 2022 match tape, women's team type, all 15 matches, 54 sets, 5,484 data points, divided into data on receiving skills (1,371 data points), setting skills (1,371 data points), attack skills (1,371 data points), and attack results (1,371 data points) are examples. Then, do a statistical analysis of the data by processing it and finding the average (M) and standard deviation (S.D.). Data analysis and statistics Calculate averages and standard deviations using data from performance analysis to obtain statistical data. Compare the average to an independent sample t-test. The results of the research showed that: 1) Reception and Digging Skill; Typing Ability; Normal There was no difference at the statistically significant level of 0.05. 2). Set skill, type excellence, and effect at the statistically significant level of 0.05. 3). Attack: Hit, Set, Tip, Push, and Hook of both the champion and opponent teams, there was no difference at the statistically significant level of 0.05. 4). In the attack skill section, enter Under and Spin. There is a 0.05 statistical difference. 5). For attack result types: out, net, block, and free, between the champion and opposing teams, there is a statistical difference of 0.05. In the attack result section, enter “block in,” “effect,” “block touch,” “win,” and “touch out.” There was no difference at the statistically significant level of 0.05. Attack Style Type Comparison between the Champion Team and the Opponent Team, there was no difference at the statistically significant level of 0.05.

articleTitle: Integrate system design and development of Global Sustainable Tourism Criteria system (GSTC)
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The key to sustainable tourism has an effective management structure. Using the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC) for assessment and benchmarking can help make tourism activities advantageous for the community's economy, culture, and environment. However, knowledge, documentation, and data must be gathered through the measurement procedure to provide an appropriate assessment. This procedure makes it difficult for some operational teams to obtain data with complicated linkages to store. Each assessment's results must be gathered by numerous users (GSTC members, experts and stakeholders). In order to collect evaluation data and assist the GSTC assessors in their work for this research, the research team established and developed a sustainability assessment system for tourist attractions based on the issues above.

articleTitle: Intangible Cultural Heritage Based Augmented Reality Mobile Learning: Application Development and Heuristics Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The popularity of Mobile has led to the rapid development of mobile learning. Especially for applications in Intangible Cultural Heritage education, many mobile learning systems have been produced. However, few systems have been evaluated for usability. In this paper, we evaluated the Intangible Cultural Heritage Based Augmented Reality Mobile Learning Application developed, using heuristic evaluation conducted by five evaluators to examine 10 heuristics. The results show that the minimalist design is more accessible for users. Finally, we have the system for our users' testing. They all think that this system can increase their knowledge of Intangible Cultural Heritage.

articleTitle: Migraine Categorization based on the Integration of EMD and Naive Bayes Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Migraine is a disabling headache that affects over one billion people in the world and is singlehandedly responsible for 42 million years of life lost to disability in 2019. Medical experts need to analyze a patient's medical history and symptoms to determine the type of migraine. It is important to produce a conclusive diagnosis because many types of migraine also have overlapping symptoms with other medical diseases. Making an accurate diagnosis may take a long time as additional medical tests in the complexity of the case. Therefore, this study proposes a computational diagnostic method through a machine learning scheme using Naïve Bayes integrated with entropy minimization discretization (EMD). The proposed method can analyze a patient's symptoms and medical history accurately to reduce the doctor's workload and fasten the diagnosis process. The results show that the Naïve Bayes classifier with EMD achieved high accuracy results; therefore, the proposed method can be a useful method for clinical practice.

articleTitle: Applying a saving algorithm for vehicle routing problems to optimize the maintenance route of the transmission station
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This paper suggests using the saving algorithm for vehicle routing problems to optimize the maintenance route of the transmission station, which has classified transmission station types into 4 types and taken into account the conditions of time spent on equipment maintenance within the station to get the route with the lowest overall cost, is suggested in this paper as a way to optimize the maintenance route of the transmission station. The experiment results show that the suggested path can lower costs by up to 82% and reduce the time from 112 to 53 days.

articleTitle: Evaluating Learner's Usability Using Codenite Educational Battle Royal Programming Language Game
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The educational game has been widely used as one of the tools for teaching and learning in programming language subject. In this paper, the Codenite game were implemented and use as a tool for an educational game which aims to determine the impact on programming self-belief. Many studies have been using programming educational games such as the puzzle game, as it positively impacts learning, situational interest, enjoyment, and self-beliefs for the learner. However, the battle royale game is a very famous type of game and it could be applied to the programming educational game for the learner to enjoy. Therefore, the Codenite game were implemented to assist the learner in learning programming courses. In this research, Codenite games were used to compare non-experienced with experienced programming language skill using Programming Self-Beliefs questionnaire. Also, comparing the learner's useability using NASA TLX and GUESS. The result shown that Codenite game delivered a good self- belief for a group of experienced programming language learner. On the other hand, the result from the NASA TLX shown that the non-experienced higher slightly difference than experienced learner. Last, the result from GUESS shown that significate differenced from both groups.

articleTitle: Implementation of Industrial Automation Sustainable Training in Savannakhet University, Laos
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The paper presents part of the work fulfilled under the Asean Factori 4.0 Erasmus+ project focused on the implementation of industrial automation in the education in 6 universities from 3 countries in South-East Asia: Thailand, Laos and Cambodia. The implementation of the project tasks, related to increasing the capacity and more precisely to the training of the professors from the Asian Universities is presented. According to the planned activities, professors from the University of Ruse conduct training for teachers from two universities: Chulalongkorn University, Thailand and Savannakhet University, Laos. The phases of training included in the project activities and how many of them have already been implemented are briefly presented. The program and the tasks of the teachers practical training for building the necessary teaching capacity in Savannakhet University and implementation of sustainable training in the field of industrial automation were presented and analyzed. Conclusions and future training of the staff of Asian universities planned under the project are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Effect of Volleyball Scoring Performance Analysis on the Women's VNL 2021 Championship Team
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Analysis of the performance of the women's volleyball team in the 2021 Volleyball Nation League provides an important performance indicator for scoring in the competition and an idea of the loss of points in the competition of the winning team against the team that competed. It was 17 matches and 112 sets. It compares the scoring performances of the championship team and the team competing with it using an independent t-test at a statistical significance level of.05 to analyze statistics. Performance analysis showed that attack (10.89±3.83 points per set), touch block (2.51±2.43 points per set), and block (2.09±1.50 points per set) were the most effective scores, and free points from opponents (4.30±2.24 points per set) were also secondary points from attacks. In terms of points loss, it was found that failing to get the ball (8.89±3.91 point per set) was the highest, followed by error attack (3.02±3.70 point per set), out (2.22±3.41 point per set), and touch (3.04±2.28 point per set) with similar points loss values. Scoring performance is a measure that creates a competitive chance to win a match. And scoring efficiency is a metric that needs to be produced in the least competitive way possible to give a team the opportunity to create an effective offensive game. A comparison of scoring and loss performance differences between the championship team and the rival team showed that attack, block, and serve were statistically different scoring performances and that scoring gains from digs and errors received were statistically significant (.05).

articleTitle: The Integration of Traditional Rural Solar Dryer with LoRa and IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Traditional or rural dryers or Thai farmers' dryers have some drawbacks when compared to modern or commercial dryers on the market. Despite the fact that the dryer is vital and may be utilized as postharvest technology to preserve or produce some agricultural products, the farmer chose to build the traditional structure because of his limited income and resources. This research examined the needs of rural farmers and developed an integration of typical rural solar dryers or dryers using IoT technologies. The integrated design will preserve the structure's materials while increasing the system's capacity and efficiency to reduce costs. Farmers may now manage the temperature inside the dryer using the newly created mechanism. Remote monitoring and management are also made possible by the technology, minimizing the need for physical intervention. This leads to increased efficiency, lower costs, and a more sustainable energy source.

articleTitle: Waste Management System using Waste Classification on Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Waste classification is an important problem for environmental management at the university because the amount of waste is in line with the number of students. Maejo University has a vision of being a green university; therefore, it places importance on waste management, starting with the process of separating waste into 10 types of 4 trash bins, which are: the blue bin is general waste, the yellow bins are recycling bins, the green bins are wet and biodegradable, and the red bins are hazardous. The inspection of each type of waste bin was studied by comparing five prototype models with the pre-train model, consisting of MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, ResNet34, VGG16, and CNN, to develop a mobile application. It was found that the MobileNetV2 model had the highest validation results. Then, the mobile application was used to inspect the waste, and the amount of waste was sorted from the largest to the smallest, namely, green bins for wet waste, yellow bins for general waste, blue bins for recyclables, and red bins for hazardous waste.

articleTitle: The Effects of Oral L-Theanine on Short-Term Memory in Middle-Aged Population
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: L-Theanine (gamma-glutamylethylamide) is a non-protein, water-soluble amino acid found primarily in green tea, particularly Camellia sinensis and edible mushrooms. It has been reported that L-Theanine contributes impact role on brain function with the preventive effect of stress and memory impairment. The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect of L-Theanine on attention and reaction time in 13 participants aged 40 to 60 years. The participants received L-Theanine (200 mg). The participants were accessed through the paradigm called Go/NoGo Task and listened two different sounds with different frequency (1000 Hertz and 2000 Hertz) and click button “Enter” immediately when the participants heard the targeted sound. The study showed that after consumption L-Theanine for 30 minutes, the attention was statistically significantly increased. However. reaction time response and numbers of accuracy and omission showed no statistically significant difference. Although it was not significant, there is potential for future studies to continue to study the effects L-Theanine in larger doses, longer duration, and more sample sizes.

articleTitle: Active Antenna Concept in Small Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Satellite communications using small satellites is one of the driving forces of the modern society with applications including weather monitoring and forecast, space exploration, telecommunications, high speed data transfer. These applications require constant communication between the satellite and the Earth, which can be a challenge for conventional communication modules and antennas. The current digital back-end realization is based on field-programmable gate array with SDR based radio frequency back end in one module. This configuration arises a lot problems connected to the heat dissipation, electromagnetic compatibility, higher mechanical requirements, and power loss in the cables. This paper proposes active antenna approach to small satellite applications in order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks of the current configuration.

articleTitle: Holographic Stereogram Portrait of a Multi-view Camera-based Digital Human
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this paper, the production process of holographic stereograms for digital human portraits, which are increasing interest in the field of holographic art, was shown. The digital human face model was produced using real-object based 3D modeling. After taking a human portrait image with 7 multi-view cameras, it was replaced with a digital human image through post processing. In order to produce digital holographic stereograms, more viewpoint images must be extracted from the face of the digital human. 768 viewpoint images were generated using the neural network multi-view interpolation method from 7 multi-view images. Finally, the process of manufacturing digital holographic stereogram of a digital human was explained, and the results of the experiment were shown.

articleTitle: The Application Of Quick Response Code Technology To Promote Cultural Tourism: Case Study of San Pu Loie
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Cultural tourism is a type of tourism that aims to learn about the culture and way of life of indigenous peoples who have their own culture. Tambon San Pu Loei in Doi Saket District, Chiang Mai is also known as cultural tourism destination where tourist gain information and experience about historical and local people way of life. However, the report from local governments mentioned that tourists had difficulty acquiring information. As a result, the community lacked the ability to communicate the local knowledge in a variety of disciplines since improper storing of data sources and met the problem of coordinates not matching the actual location of the place. In this study, the two-dimensional bar code technology (QR Code) was improved and employed on location-based services for promoting the cultural tourism and utilizing to tackle the problem of tourists accessing information. 83 travelers were involved in this study. Satisfaction level is measured based on 3 parts: content, design, and useful. The overall result of tourist satisfaction who scanned the QR code and visited the website (www.dekdoi-travel.com) is also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Extended algorithm for current slope estimation in inverter fed synchronous machines
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The present work describes an extension of current slope estimation for parameter estimation of permanent magnet synchronous machines operated at inverters. The area of operation for current slope estimation in the individual switching states of the inverter is limited due to measurement noise, bandwidth limitation of the current sensors and the commutation processes of the inverter's switching operations. Therefore, a minimum duration of each switching state is necessary, limiting the final area of operation of a robust current slope estimation. This paper presents an extension of existing current slope estimation algorithms resulting in a greater area of operation and a more robust estimation result.

articleTitle: Musical Activities as performance Support for the Working Memory of Hearing Impaired Children
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study examined whether musical activities improve working memory in hearing-impaired youngsters. Due to weak working memory., hearing-impaired youngsters fail to recall.,comprehend., and apply knowledge. Hearing-impaired children may improve their working memory through creativity. A musical exercise that was creative helped with working memory. The creative thinking theory., which links creative thought to working memory., was used to solve this study's challenge. Movement improvisation and rhythm composition resulted from Orff and Kodaly's musical activities. This quasi-experimental study is quantitative. This study had 16 targeted sample subjects divided into experimental and control groups. Data analysis uses paired sample t-tests. The significant value of the paired sample t-test is 0.003 (sig. 2 tailed = 0.003 p 0.05)., and the N-gain effectiveness test is 60.2083 or 60%. This study found that: (1) musical creativity can support hearing impaired children's working memory performance; (2) musical activity using the Orff learning method is a fairly effective treatment for improving working memory performance; (3) hearing impaired children's musical rhythm perceptions can be achieved through figural abilities and visual memory; and (4) experimental tasks affect working memory performance.

articleTitle: Analytical of Performance Indicators ROV Pro League 2021 Winter Grand Final
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This analytical research study aimed to analyze the performance indicators of the ROV Pro League 2021 Winter, the Grand Final of the last four teams that affect the competition. And compare the differences in performance indicators between winning and losing games. The competition will be held from October 16–17, 2021. By analyzing the matches and video recordings of the partners in this tournament, there are 4 matches, 23 games, and 2,567 data points. The study found that the indicators of ability that were different between winning and losing games consisted of: 1) the ability to destroy enemy turrets (tower): the winning team averaged 7.17±1.37, the losing team averaged 2.56±2.19 per game. 2) Killing ability of the Dark Slayer Lane position, the winning team averaged 1.74±1.81, the losing team averaged 0.61±0.98 per game. 3) Killing ability (Mid Lane) The winning team has an average of 2.52±1.83. The losing team has an average of 0.96±0.87 per game. 4) In terms of the assist ability of the Dark Slayer Lane position, the winning team averaged 4.26±2.81 the losing team averaged 1.65±1.61 per game. 5) The damage ability of the Mid Lane position, the winning team is average 97,299±35,220 the losing team is average 89,694±56,783 per game. 6) Given the damage ability of the Abyssal Dragon Lane location, the winning team is averaging 102,144±48,842 the losing team averages 71,500±29,502 per game.

articleTitle: Smart City Problem Analysis By Using Design Thinking
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The training Course under project “City Data Planner (CDP)” aimed to facilitate the change of sustainable smart city development. The local governance organization over 70 municipalities around Thailand were involved in the project. Knowledge and comprehension of city data is required to construct smart cities in multiple aspects. The utilization of information and technology to drive local government organizations has the potential to create a viable smart city. The aim of this paper is to survey the requirement of local government organization in order to adopt smart city technology in their workplace.

articleTitle: Using a Screening Risk of Dyslexia Game to Evaluate Students with Learning Disabilities Through the Use of Language-Independent Content and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for global dyslexia screening based on machine learning framework and data collected from a screening risk of dyslexia online game. This research aims to explore students with Learning Disabilities. We developed the game's content by analyzing the errors made by students with dyslexia in many languages, as other dyslexia-related criteria include audio and visual processing. Our approach involves gathered data to train predictive machine learning models. Using Random Visual game and Random audio game respectively, the findings achieve effective results. Screening for a dyslexia risk game. Our approach can be used to screen students with disorder and hence aiding a potential early intervention.

articleTitle: Blended learning-driven interdisciplinary project-based approach: Gender differences in learning achievement and perceptions of university students
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Blended learning is an educational strategy integrating online educational resources and engagement possibilities with traditional learning. Flipped classroom and inquiry-based learning refer to blended learning, emphasizing students' participation in learning by working collaboratively. Such a learning process motivates the students to relate to and apply experiential knowledge until their learning behaviors change and they can apply knowledge and skills in their daily lives. The emphasis is on students' roles and participation through various learning modes. In addition, the teachers have been recommended to change their roles from knowledge transfer to coaching, triggering the students to learn through systematic analytical thinking through knowledge exchange between teachers and students. Consequently, this study integrated system analysis and instructional design into the web programming course, focusing on students' abilities to analyze and apply system principles for the business sector in an interdisciplinary model. The teacher planned and designed lessons and learning activities inside and outside classes by assigning projects integrating the contents of both courses for the students; they would create concepts for solving problems in the same direction. The data analysis revealed that: (a) male students have higher average scores than female students, (b) female students perform better than male students in learning activities and perceived usefulness dimention, and (b) male students perform better than female students in learning environments dimention. Furthermore, this suggested approach enhances students' ability to effectively apply knowledge and skills in their studies or future occupations.

articleTitle: The Proposed Wind-gate Monitoring System for Teaching and Learning Thai Traditional Massage
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Traditional Thai massage teaching methods such as lectures, demonstrations, and manual practice can be time-consuming and ineffective in conveying complicated techniques and concepts, especially for an online course. Without real-time monitoring and feedback, it might be impossible for students to discover and improve their specific strengths and limitations in massage methods. Furthermore, trainees may have limited opportunity to practice and enhance their abilities, particularly if they do not live near a massage training academy. The study proposed an IoT-based wind-gate system as a tool for teaching and learning Thai massage. The system can enhance and improve the massage treatment process by offering real-time monitoring, a personalized approach, data-driven insights, remote access, and cost-effectiveness with lower error rates when compared to commercial measuring instruments.

articleTitle: Implement of Curricula in Industry 4.0 Context Faculty of Engineering, National University of Laos
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Cultivating the engineer to meet industrial needs is a big challenge as always. The NUOL is one of the universities that has frequently developed teaching strategies to achieve a good education. This paper is to propose a mission of the faculty of engineering, NUOL, to improve teaching methodology through the ASEAN Factori 4.0 project in which the department of electronics and telecommunication is focused. The philosophy and objectives in the curriculum of the electronics program is presented. The Programmable Logic Controller course is concentrated. To implement the PLC curriculum effectively, a training of teaching assistants is conducted, the class capacity is considered, and the teaching materials are created. Through the course, learning outcomes were assessed, the results of which are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Video Creative Music-Based Tutorial as a Media to Enhanced Students Social Emotional Well Being
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Musical video tutorials measure student self-efficacy. Creative kids explore, adapt, and integrate sound. Digital media prepares children for globalization. Media aids learning. Homeschoolers learn. E-learning is great during COVID-19. Distance learning involves self-study, media, and no teacher-student contact. Educating kids, parents, and teachers enhances home and school learning. Distance education is “education in which students are separated from the teacher and learning takes place using various learning resources through communication technology, information, and other media”. Thus, video tutorial-based e-learning, formerly audiovisual-free, can improve online teacher-student learning, especially in primary school music instruction, where teachers lack inventiveness. This art-based research collects quantitative survey and qualitative focus group data via a quasi-experiment. Compared to the control group's 0.953 and 0.8511, the treatment group scored 0.492 and averaged 0.91489. Video lectures taught the experimental group creative music. Multimedia-enhanced video lesson learning in parent-teacher focus groups Online instruction can enhance the music learning methodology. Thus, video tutorials increase early primary music students' emotional well-being.

articleTitle: Experimental Platform Measuring Semantic Information and Semantic Heterogeneous Data Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The use of semantic information necessitates a quantitative assessment of the information in general. This article will provide an overview and analysis of the present state of semantic information measurement as methods and algorithms for semantic data reduction. We propose an algorithm combining initial information classification, knowledge enrichment through keywords, identification of potential semantic correlations between them, and semantic information extraction.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Classification of Metabolic Syndrome Group Using Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Currently, metabolic syndrome, the leading cause of most of non-communicable diseases, has been overlooked because it is common and does not cause illness at the early stage. The purpose of this study was to classify the group of metabolic syndromes including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and high blood pressure using machine learning based method. The data was collected from three sub-districts in the province of Chiang Rai: Mae Khao Tom, Nang Lae, and Tha Sud totally 1,605 records. The Gradient Boosting is proposed for the multi-class classification model. From the comparison results with other existing methods, including Random Forest, Extra Trees, K-nearest Neighbor, Support Vector Machines, and Decision Trees, Gradient Boosting outperforms other existing methods having 95.27% accuracy, 95.24% precision, 95.26% recall, and 95.24% F1 score, respectively.

articleTitle: Analytic Hierarchy Process-based group Decision-Making Approach to Logistics Staff Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Since 2020, the COVID-19 epidemic has presented logistics companies in Thailand with workforce issues. Many businesses in Thailand's logistics and distribution industries have attempted to run their operations despite the risks of hiring potential unskilled workers, which could result in unsatisfactory performance. This research aims to study the staff recruitment criteria in the logistics industry by using a case study. This research employs Analytic Hierarchy Process for ranking factors based on group decision-makers. Decision-makers were purposively selected to score the questionnaire survey. The results show that the highest weight was factor A (experience). The second and third ranks were factor B (knowledge) and D (driving skills). Moreover, the case study did not interest the certificate (factor C).

articleTitle: Center of Excellence for Control and Automation in the Context of ASEAN Factori 4.0 Project
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The innovative learning laboratory based on an industrial Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) is very important allowing students to perform practices under actual industrial conditions. In the ASEAN Factori 4.0 Erasmu+ project, each Asian partner university will have its own center of excellence with the PLC platform for industrial automation applications developed by the EU partner universities. This paper presents the elements of the center of excellence in conjunction with the existing pedagogical platforms in the department of Electrical and Energy Engineering at the Institute of Technology of Cambodia.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MIMO FSO Communication system over $\mathcal{M}$-distributed Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Currently, a new statistical model named málaga or <tex>$\mathcal{M}$</tex>-distribution was proposed to model the atmospheric turbulence channel. All existing traditional statistical channel models can be derived from this. Atmospheric turbulence degrades the performance of a free space optical communication (FSO) system. Spatial diversity is a promising technique to enhance the performance of the system. In this article, an FSO system is analyzed with spatial diversity with on-off keying modulation over <tex>$\mathcal{M}$</tex>-distributed turbulent channel. A novel closed-form expression for bit error rate is derived for the proposed FSO systems over this channel and analyzed the effects of pointing errors.

articleTitle: The Study of Customer Behavior through Buying Cosmetic Products for Designing the Knowledge Pack for Thai Cosmetic Sellers
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Due to COVID-19, traveling between China and Thailand is limited strictly. It's hard for Chinese customers to buy Thai cosmetic products in Thailand. This paper aims at providing some suggestions for Thai cosmetic sellers by designing a knowledge pack of marketing strategy. The FFF model (online customer behavior) will be used to design questions for the online questionnaire, questions are chosen by using IOC (Index of congruence) with 3 experts. Random sampling method will be used to collect raw data from 414 respondents via an online questionnaire platform. The raw data of all questions will be analyzed for different reports, and top-5 ranking questions will be analyzed in more detail to come up with suitable suggestions to solve these problems. Some strategies and the knowledge pack will be made to help cosmetic sellers have a better understanding of the Chinese market like Chinese customer behavior, important factors of Chinese customers' most concern, and strategy design based on price formulation, the online platform choosing, overseas logistics and new retailing.

articleTitle: Implementing PID Control on PLC Benchmark to Enhance Industrial Automation Skills Towards ASEAN FACTORI 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The “Asean Factori 4.0” project under Erasmus+ programme CBHE supported the PLC training and benchmark to the Center of Excellence in Intelligent Control Automation of Process Systems (ICAPS) at Chulalongkorn University (CU). Various PLC projects including PID-type feedback control loop that would be utilized as an in-class tool to enhance understanding of PID principle and effects of tuning parameters on the process was programmed using the CODESYS software with Visualization. The PLC projects were executed on the PLC benchmark with visualization on an HMI display designed by the GALILEO software. The curriculum modification to include Industry 4.0 (I4.0) and PLC as well as conducting seminars on PLC by ICAPS guarantees sustainability of the “Asean Factori 4.0” project.

articleTitle: Application of Pose Estimation on Webcam for Fall Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Fall risk assessment is an effective and simple measure to evaluate the balance of people especially the elderly who are likely to have balance disorder. Lose of body balance increases a fall risk which could lead to severe damage to aging persons. In this paper, we propose to apply pose estimation technique based on PoseNet method to detect body joints from webcam's video for two types of fall risk assessment: Five Times Sit to Stand Test (FTSTS) and 30-Second Chair Stand Test (30CST). The experiments were performed with 17 volunteers concurrently with the measures of a healthcare expert. The results revealed that our proposed technique corresponds well with the measure of the expert evaluating by a Pearson correlation coefficient which equals to 0.903 and 0.980 for FTSTS and 30CST respectively.

articleTitle: Solving the Capacitated Electric Vehicle (EV) Routing Problem by The Differential Evolutionary Algorithm with Adaptive K-Means
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This article is designed for solving the routing problem that limit of the electric energy and workload, called the Capacitated Electric Vehicle Routing Problem (CEVRP). The objective of this problem is to search for the optimal routing of a vehicle contain a limited electric energy and goods. The proposed model is based on the concepts of the differential evolutionary (DE) algorithm and the adaptive k-mean algorithm, in addition, the fuzzy technique is also applied with the aim to achieve best overall performance. In order to improve the efficiency of the DE, several aspects have been adopted, such as (1) The proposed model is employed the adaptive K-means algorithm to obtain the ability to search for the best initial solution, (2) The fuzzy technique is determined as the decision making technique which decided when one customer is in-between several clusters and (3) The local and global swap method is introduced to increase the exploitation and exploration capability. The proposed model has been evaluated and compared to the state-of-the-art algorithm in term of the average percentage deviation from the lower bound.

articleTitle: Approach to Develop Communication Skills and Acceptability in Health and Wellness Product Provider in Anti-Aging Science
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: With increasing demand for health and wellness products, it is imperative for providers to adopt strong leadership skills to effectively educate consumers on product facts, communicate professionally, gain the customers' acceptance, and provide customer-centric services to avoid misuse and misinformation. The goal of this research is to study approaches to developing communication skills and acceptability among health and wellness product providers in anti-aging science. A qualitative research method of in-depth interviews with a Delphi technique approach was used to gather insights from 17 purposively selected experts with a Diamond or above ranking and with at least 5 years of experience in Amway business, as Amway was one of the best-known examples of health and wellness product provider companies in the industry. The results were assessed using content analysis, determining the prioritized development methods. It was found that content preparation and broad knowledge, mentor coaching and evaluation, and learning concise and understandable communication tactics were the top 3 approaches to achieving communication skills as a leadership trait. Meanwhile, updating knowledge on a regular basis, having mentors as role models, communicating with proofs, and not answering randomly if uncertain were the top 3 approaches to developing acceptability. This study provides crucial insights into the creation of future effective and more widely accepted communicators as leaders for health and wellness product promotion in the anti-aging industry.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Deep Learning Algorithm for Forest Fire Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The forest fire caused further destruction to the woodland region. It must be monitored and detected as early as possible. In the study, the pre-trained deep learning performance of Inception, ResNet, and ViT was compared for the categorization of photos of forest fires. These models' performances are evaluated with one another. The findings from the study indicate that the ViT model has the best accuracy at 88.03%. The ResNet-26, ResNet-50, Inception v3, and Inception v4 models have an accuracy of 86.66%, 85.64%, 83.25%, and 80.86%, respectively.

articleTitle: Discover Congenital Amusia in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study was designed to screen for Thai-speaking individuals with the classic presentation of congenital amusia. Congenital amusia is an observed neurological phenomenon defined as an inability or difficulty of the brain to process and produce musical sounds. Individuals who have congenital amusia are unable to recognize or hum, sing, or whistle familiar songs, even if they have normal audiometry and above-average intellectual and memory skills. Congenital amusia is observed from birth and is not associated with a physical injury or damage to the brain. The study of congenital amusia reveals the methodology used for screening this neurological condition is a digitally form of the Montreal Battery of Evaluation of Amusia (MBEA), which has served as the standard prescribed method of assessment since its inception by Isabelle Peretz in the 2002 pilot study of amusia. Initial hypotheses suggested that due to the fine-pitch granularity of Thai tonal language, there would be a lower rate of discovery for congenital amusia in a Thai-speaking population than in the original English- and French-speaking sample populations. Preliminary results support the initial hypothesis by revealing no discoveries of congenital amusia in the small number of Thai-speaking population sample.

articleTitle: Identification of SOZ and Influence on Neutral Current and Flux Distribution Capability in a Y-y Power Transformer Subjected to DC Bias
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In line with the advancement in technology there is an extensive use of power electronics in the power systems as the demand for more efficient and smart energy grows. The widespread use of power electronics in power transformers can introduce dc bias into the system, causing it to change operating point, generate harmonics and increase excitation current. In this work we have modeled a Y-y type 11kV/433V natural air-cooled power transformer using Ansys Maxwell software. This model has been analyzed using the finite element method. A comprehensive analysis of the flux distribution capability and the influence on the neutral current in a dc biased transformer was performed. This study provides new insights into various zones of operation of the dc biased transformer. The resulting nonlinearity of operation with increasing dc bias could lead in leakage flux, neutral current, and losses, causing a lower lifetime expectancy and poor power quality over time. Collectively, our analysis demonstrates that identifying different operating zones and operating the transformer in the safe operating zone (SOZ) can extend the life of a transformer while also providing significant safety and reliability benefits.

articleTitle: Requirement Traceability Matrix for SaaS Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Very small entities (VSEs) have experienced numerous difficulties in the midst of the extremely competitive software market. They typically manifest as increased customer expectations, frequent changes in user needs, and the need for rapid deployment. The most popular choice for development architecture is software as a service (SaaS). It can replace the role of an outdated system and react immediately to user input. The service delivery standard ISO/IEC 29110-4-3 outlines the process for implementing services while guaranteeing their quality. In this study, the requirement traceability matrix was designed to solve the requirement of service problems.

articleTitle: An Analysis of ICT Students' Satisfaction with the Performance of the University of Phayao Service Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The University of Phayao provides school buses for students to travel within the university. Students can take the service bus from the main gate to several bus stops within the university. The School of Information and Communication Technology (school of ICT) is one of the schools of the University of Phayao and contains more than a thousand students. Free bus service for students every 30–60 minutes to the university junction. This research work was planned in a cross-sectional descriptive type to determine the satisfaction level of students who use the school buses traveling to and from the school of ICT. It found that the least satisfactory factors are service frequency and service vehicle numbers, with a score of 2.66 and 2.9, respectively. However, the overall satisfaction score is 3.18; the meaning is high satisfaction. service frequency and the number of vehicles are the least satisfied attributes, while overall satisfaction is high, with a score is at 3.18.

articleTitle: TransEN U-Net: Enhance Image Segmentation of Cytomegalovirus Infected Cells in Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Advances in histopathological image segmentation have a significant role in the diagnosis and begin treatment immediately including a study of Cytomegalovirus(CMV) for the tissues. Histopathological change with confirmation by immuno-histochemical or in situ hybridization study is a gold standard for diagnosis of CMV tissue infection. This required pathologists to identify the histopathological change which is time-consuming and can be missed in tissue with a subtle change. Automatic analysis of histopathological images with Deep Learning(DL) can help pathologists to diagnose CMV tissue infection more accurately. Typical issues with histopathological images which impede automatic analysis are the extremely enormous size of histopathological images more than 1 gigapixel, the limitations of GPU memory, and a limited number of histopathology images. Additionally, whole slide histopathological images are split huge images into multiple small image patches by cropping using the sliding window technique. In this paper, we propose TransEN U-Net which derives a benefit of a hybrid CNN-Transformer base on the U-shaped architecture for boosting the performance of segmentation of histopathology. The transformer encoder not only is able to the patches but also the relative self-attention mechanism in order to share information between sequences. Experiment results of segmenting images by the two-dimensional indicate that the TransEN U-Net can productively discriminate CMV viral inclusions including achieving higher values in terms of DSC score.

articleTitle: Design of 3D-Printed Lens for Ultra-Wideband Flower-Shaped Stub Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The design of 3D-printed lens for ultra-wideband (UWB) slot antenna with flower-shaped stub is presented. This research presents four types of lenses with different shapes i.e., cone lens, semicircle lens, Fresnel lens and hemispherical lens that are mounted on an UWB planar antenna. The effect of these lenses on reflection coefficient, gain, and radiation pattern is proposed. The simulation results show that all four lenses, which are combined with an UWB planar antenna. The operating band of the designed antenna starts at 3.1 GHz to 10.6 GHz. Moreover, using these lenses, the antenna characteristics, e.g., antenna gain, and antenna radiation patterns are enhanced. The average gain at zero degree of the antenna without a lens is 1.94 dBi, while the average gain at the same angle of the antenna with four types of lenses are increased more than 1.1 dBi. Four shaped of the lens, e.g., cone, semicircle, Fresnel, and hemispherical, are selected to modify the gain and radiation pattern of UWB flower-shaped stub antenna. After implement the lens, the gains of the antenna at zero degree are increased to 3.09 dBi, 3.35 dBi, 3.72 dBi, and 5.07 dBi, respectively. In addition, the radiation pattern of the antenna without an additive lens is bi-directional pattern, but when adding a lens, the radiation pattern changes to a unidirectional one. It is found that a hemispherical lens is a good choice for the proposed antenna because it has a higher gain than other lenses. Furthermore, this study is useful for lens selection to enhance UWB antenna performance.

articleTitle: Anagram Technique: The Investigation of Tonal Music into New Frequencies for Composition
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: This study aims to find new frequencies in creating works of art, especially musical compositions using anagrams with the way permutations work. This way is to explore in such a way as to discover new sounds and new frequencies of existing western tonal music. Anagrams are one way to dismantle the tonal of western music to find new frequencies in musical composition techniques. The results of this study from 12 tones (A, Bb, B, C, C#, D, Eb, E, F, G, Ab) of western music with anagrams through permutation processing techniques obtained 60 frequencies using not 12 western tonal tones, then 48 new frequencies were obtained through this anagram. From these results, a frequency of 38 Hz – 986 Hz was obtained. The conclusion from the use of anagram techniques turned out to be able to produce new frequencies in the musical region.

articleTitle: Virtual Collaboration in Mixed Reality for Enhancing Business Model Innovation
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate how using Mixed Reality can add one more layer of interactivity thus extending and enhancing the capabilities of the unique Business Model Innovation tool - the BeeCube. The participants in the Business Model Innovation process can utilize the physical structure of the BeeCubee, collaborate using the virtual Bee tools, or work within a virtual BeeCube without necessarily being in the real physical environment. While brainstorming and working together on a new or existing product, the collaborators in the BeeCube can import different 3D Bee tools, add spatial drawings, and annotations to visualize their ideas helping to improve the mutual understanding of the Business Model Innovation process and enhance the collaboration. The developed User Interface is based on intuitive interactions based on hand tracking, gesture, and speech recognition.

articleTitle: Industrial requirements analysis for Excellence Center setting-up and curriculum design in Industry 4.0 context
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The needs of industrial workforces have changed in the Industry 4.0 era. The knowledge worker in charge of information systems and internal operations was divided into different roles, and they each used different working methods and concepts. Despite this, Industry 4.0's consolidation has promoted the growth of servicing workforce with both computational complexity and equipment maintenance skills. An industrial requirements analysis is conducted in this paper to identify the key skills and competencies needed for setting up and designing an Excellence Center in the context of Industry 4.0. A diverse group of industry experts are surveyed to gather their insights on the most important areas of focus for such a center. The findings indicate that the key competencies needed for success in an Industry 4.0 setting include digital literacy, data analysis, and the ability to work with advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. Based on these findings, a curriculum for the Excellence Center is proposed that prioritizes these competencies and includes hands-on training and practical experience. Overall, this paper contributes to the understanding of the requirements for Industry 4.0 and provides a roadmap for setting up and designing an Excellence Center to meet these requirements.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Enhanced Deep Residual Networks for Single-image Super-Resolution Model with Change in Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: Super-resolution technology is receiving a lot of attention to restore low-resolution images to high-resolution. Among several models, we use an enhanced deep super-resolution network model that outperforms a single image. EDSR maximizes the efficiency of learning by using residual blocks with batch normalization removed from residual blocks of ResNet, enabling fast and good accuracy learning. We compared loss functions such as mean absolute error (MAE), mean square error (MSE), and binary cross-entropy (BCE) for resolution x4 bicubic down sampling images using Enhanced Deep Super-Resolution Network (EDSR). The mean absolute error (MAE) showed the best performance, and the mean square error (MSE) also showed compliance performance that could not be distinguished by the human eye. On the other hand, binary cross-entropy (BCE) showed significantly lower performance. In future studies, it is judged that a performance comparative experiment according to the optimal hyper-parameters for each scale is necessary. It is also an applicable technique for fast transmission of high-resolution images.

articleTitle: Accreditation of PLC course in Royal University of Phnom Penh to meet Factori 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunications Engineering (ECTI DAMT & NCON)
abstract: The accreditation of programmable logic controller (PLC) course is presented in this paper to meet the Factori 4.0. This accreditation course is implementation through seminars, discussions, training, survey, and evaluation by quality assurance.
